ITEM.PTXT: For the windshield glass, high sound insulation glass has been adopted, which has a sound insulation layer of special resin between the interlayers and suppresses the coincidence phenomenon, reducing the noise entering the cabin and ensuring excellent sound insulation performance.

"Green tempered UV-cut glass", which is heat-absorbing glass with an added ultraviolet-cutting component, has been provided for the front door glass, front fixed window glass, rear door glass and rear door quarter window glass depending on the specification. The front door glass has a water-repellent function to ensure visibility when driving in rain, etc.

"Privacy glass (dark gray)", which makes the cabin difficult to see from behind the vehicle to protect privacy, has been adopted for the rear door glass, rear door quarter window glass and back door glass, and provided depending on the specification.
A phenomenon in which sound waves of a certain frequency entering the glass cause a kind of resonance, reducing sound insulation performance.
Heat-absorbing glass with an infrared-cutting function, with an added ultraviolet-cutting component.
Glass that makes the cabin difficult to see from outside to protect privacy, blocks infrared rays (near-infrared rays) with a large heating effect, and also cuts ultraviolet rays.

A water-repellent film is coated on the glass surface. This reduces the adhesion of raindrops when driving in rain, ensuring visibility of the outer rear view mirrors and to the sides. It also has the effect of reducing condensation, icing and adhesion of muddy water, etc., and making them easier to remove.

The water-repellent effect lasts for a limited period. To maintain the water-repellent performance for a long time, clean the door glass with a soft, damp cloth as soon as possible when it becomes dirty.

When cleaning the door glass, do not use detergents or wax containing compound. (If the glass becomes cloudy white when using glass cleaner, wipe it off with a damp cloth.) In addition, do not use an automatic car wash or repeatedly raise and lower the door glass when it is heavily soiled with mud, etc. This may cause loss of the water-repellent effect or scratch the glass.
If the glass is frozen, do not scrape it off with a metal plate, etc. This may cause loss of the water-repellent effect or scratch the glass.
"Retractable remote control outer mirrors with turn signal lights" are standard on all models. For details, refer to the Power Mirror System.

A rain clearing blue mirror, which combines a rain clearing mirror layer with functions such as a self-cleaning effect and a blue mirror layer with low reflectance in the daytime and high reflectance at night, has been adopted on the mirror surface to ensure stable rear visibility.
Cold area specification models have a heater inside the mirror.
The rain clearing blue mirror is a front-surface mirror with a Cr reflective layer coated on the glass surface, and its structure prevents double images through surface reflection.

Through the interference effect of the 2 layers, with a titania layer coated on the surface of the Cr reflective layer, and a reflectance adjustment layer sandwiched in between, the reflected light is made blue without tinting the glass. This enhances the effect of reducing glare from reflected light and the effect of cutting ultraviolet and infrared rays.

The silica layer has a hydrophilic effect that spreads water droplets adhering to the surface into a thin film. In addition, the hydrophilic effect is enhanced by giving the silica layer surface an uneven texture.

The titania layer has a self-cleaning effect that chemically decomposes and removes dirt adhering to the silica layer surface through photocatalytic action that reacts with sunlight (ultraviolet rays).

Material surfaces in the atmosphere are broadly divided into hydrophilic surfaces, which bond easily with water, and hydrophobic surfaces, which do not bond easily (tend to repel water). Ordinary mirror surfaces are covered with hydrophobic substances (dirt, etc.), so when water adheres, it forms hemispherical droplets due to surface tension.

The rain clearing blue mirror has a hydrophilic silica layer on its surface that bonds easily with water, and the outermost surface of the silica has an uneven structure to hold a large amount of water. As a result, when water adheres, it is spread into a thin film to ensure visibility. If dirt adheres directly to the outermost surface of the silica layer, the hydrophilic effect may decrease, but when exposed to sunlight (ultraviolet rays), the hydrophilic effect can be restored by the self-cleaning effect.

When exposed to sunlight (ultraviolet rays), electrons (e-) are generated inside the titania layer, and the electrons pass through the silica layer and are adsorbed by and excite the surrounding oxygen (O2), changing it into active oxygen (O2-). (Fig. A) This active oxygen chemically reacts with dirt (organic matter) adhering to the silica layer surface, decomposing the dirt into carbon dioxide (CO2) and water (H2O) and removing it. (Fig. B)

The reflected color is blue, and by lowering the reflectance of yellow and red light (long wavelength range), which feels particularly glaring in the bright "daytime", glare from sunlight and headlights is reduced.
In the dark "nighttime", reflectance equivalent to that of an untinted mirror is ensured to maintain visibility. In addition, the effect of cutting infrared and ultraviolet rays is also enhanced.

Washing with water alone is sufficient when cleaning the mirror surface. Rubbing the mirror surface with an oil film remover (compound, etc.) or a cloth with sand on it, or applying wax, water repellent, etc., may damage or attack the silica/titania layers coated on the mirror surface and cause loss of the hydrophilic effect.
If the mirror surface is frozen, do not scrape it off with a plastic plate, etc.; thaw it with running water or warm water.

Under the following conditions, the hydrophilic effect temporarily decreases, but this is not a malfunction. The hydrophilic effect recovers with several days of sunlight; to restore the effect quickly, clean the mirror according to the procedure described in the Repair Manual.

TABLE.TITLE: Conditions Causing Temporary Decrease in Hydrophilic Effect

ITEM.PTXT: When the mirror surface is touched with bare hands, or dirt on the mirror surface is wiped off with an oily cloth, etc.
When the vehicle is parked for a long period in a place not exposed to sunlight, such as an underground parking lot.
When wax remover used to remove vehicle wax adheres.
When wax adheres from an automatic car wash.

An automatic anti-glare EC (electrochromic) mirror, which detects the brightness of the surroundings and the rear with sensors and automatically changes the reflectance, has been adopted on grades other than the standard grade, and a manual anti-glare mirror has been adopted on the standard grade.
Stepless control of the automatic anti-glare EC mirror reflectivity provides excellent dimming performance.
A shift light that illuminates the shift lever area has been provided at the bottom of the automatic anti-glare EC mirror.
The automatic anti-glare EC mirror contains a sensor that detects ambient light and a sensor that detects rear light.

In automatic anti-glare mode, day or night is determined based on the intensity of the ambient light; when it is determined to be night and the rear light is detected to be stronger than the ambient light, the mirror reflectivity is adjusted steplessly between approximately 7% (when the difference between rear light and ambient light is large) and approximately 75% (when the difference between rear light and ambient light is small) according to the ratio of rear light to ambient light.

When the IG is turned ON, the AUTO mode indicator light illuminates and automatic anti-glare control is performed. Even if AUTO mode was turned OFF during the previous IG ON, automatic anti-glare control is performed when the IG is turned ON.
When the surroundings are bright (determined to be daytime), the reflectivity is adjusted to the maximum value (approximately 75%: equivalent to a normal mirror).
When the surroundings are dark (determined to be night), the reflectivity is automatically adjusted steplessly between normal and maximum anti-glare according to the rear brightness.
Automatic anti-glare control can be cancelled by pressing the AUTO mode switch to the "OFF" side. In this case, the reflectivity is fixed at the maximum value (approximately 75%).

A gel type EC mirror cell (a solution-type electrochromic material sandwiched between transparent conductive coatings) has been adopted, providing an anti-glare structure using the electrochromism phenomenon.
A phenomenon in which a material is colorless when no voltage is applied, and becomes colored through an electrochemical oxidation-reduction reaction when voltage is applied.
When the IG is turned ON, current is supplied to the ambient light/rear light sensors, and each sensor outputs a detection signal.

The detection signal from the ambient light sensor is output to the day/night judgment circuit, and the detection signals from the ambient light and rear light sensors are output to the glare judgment circuit. These circuits judge the ambient and rear illuminance, and output a judgment signal to the EC drive circuit via the "AUTO" mode switch. When the EC drive circuit receives the judgment signal, it applies a corresponding voltage to the inner mirror EC element to color it, thereby controlling the mirror reflectivity.
A lock current detection type has been adopted for the power retract/return circuit built into the mirror.
A push-lock type mirror retract switch has been adopted and located on the right side of the instrument panel on the driver side.
"Retractable remote control outer mirrors", which have a power retract/return remote control function in addition to remote control of the mirror surface from inside the cabin, have been provided.
When the retract/return switch is pressed with both mirrors in the retracted position, both the left and right mirrors return.
If one mirror is manually moved from the retracted position to the return position, the mirror holds that position. If the retract/return switch is pressed at this time, only that one mirror returns.
When the retract/return switch is pressed with both mirrors in the return position, both the left and right mirrors retract.

If one mirror is manually moved from the return position to the forward-folded position, the mirror holds that position. If the retract/return switch is pressed at this time, both the left and right mirrors retract.

If one mirror is manually moved from the return position to the retracted position, the mirror holds that position. If the retract/return switch is pressed at this time, only that one mirror retracts.
If the mirror hits an obstacle during retraction/return operation, a fail-safe function stops the mirror in the position where its movement is blocked by the obstacle, preventing damage.
If the mirror stops at an intermediate position due to the fail-safe function, it can be moved to the retracted or return position by operating the switch after removing the obstacle.

With ACC ON or IG ON, when the outer mirror switch is locked in the pushed-in position <protruding position>, the retract side switch <return side switch> turns ON, and current flows to the retract/return motor via the retract/return circuit (motor lock current detection circuit), operating the motor.
When the mirror moves to the retracted position <return position> and the retract/return circuit detects motor lock, the circuit cuts off the current and the retract/return motor stops.
"Retractable remote control outer mirrors with turn signal lights" are standard on all models. For details, refer to the Power Mirror System.

"Retractable remote control outer mirrors with mirror heaters" with a timer function (approximately 15 minutes) have been provided depending on the specifications.
A push type switch has been adopted and located in the air conditioning control panel. The switch is shared by the mirror heaters and rear window defogger.

INDICATE.TITLE: Mirror Heater System Components Main Function List

ENTRY.PTXT: Retractable Remote Control Outer Mirror with Mirror Heater Function

ITEM.PTXT: The built-in panel type heater heats up when the rear window defogger relay turns ON.
Sends the mirror heater operation request signal to the air conditioning ECU.
When the operation request signal is received from the air conditioning control panel, turns the rear window defogger relay ON and drives the mirror heaters.

When the rear window defogger switch (also used as the mirror heater switch) in the air conditioning control panel is turned ON with IG ON, the rear window defogger (mirror heater) operation request signal is sent to the air conditioning ECU via LIN communication. The air conditioning ECU that receives this signal turns the rear window defogger relay ON, and the mirror heaters heat up.
A rear window defogger has been adopted on cold area specification models. In addition, a rear window defogger with a timer function (approximately 15 minutes) has been adopted.
The rear window defogger switch is located in the air conditioning control panel.
With timer function only

When the rear window defogger switch is turned ON with IG ON, the operation request signal is sent to the air conditioning computer via LIN communication. When the air conditioning computer that receives this signal turns the rear window defogger relay ON, the rear window defogger heats up.
A windshield deicer with a timer function (approximately 15 minutes) has been adopted on cold area specification models.

The heating elements of the windshield deicer are provided at the front wiper stop position (upper part of the cowl panel) and reversing position (right front pillar), to prevent the front wipers from locking or being damaged by snow and ice accumulated on the windshield glass.
The windshield deicer switch has a built-in operation indicator light and timer circuit, and is located on the right side of the instrument panel on the driver side.
When the windshield deicer switch is turned ON with IG ON, the windshield deicer relay turns ON and the windshield deicer heats up.
